title: Jump loci of fibre cohomology of a perfect complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be a pseudo-coherent complex [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex] in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] (for example, a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex]). For each integer $i$ define $\beta_i(x)=\dim_{\kappa(x)}H^i(Li_x^*E)$ for $x\in X$. Then formation of $\beta_i$ commutes with arbitrary base change, each $\beta_i$ is upper semicontinuous, and every level set of $\beta_i$ is locally constructible.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma jump-loci, Tag 0BDI

proof.text: Fix a point $x\in X$ and choose an affine neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ of $x$. By the local bounded-above finite-free characterization in [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], represent $E|_U$ by a bounded-above complex $F^\bullet$ of finite free $A$-modules. Replace $F^\bullet$ by the stupid truncation $K=\sigma_{\ge i-1}F^\bullet$; it is bounded and finite free, and for every $y\in U$ the complexes $K\otimes_A\kappa(y)$ and $F^\bullet\otimes_A\kappa(y)$ have the same degree-$i$ cohomology. By [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback], termwise pullback computes the derived fibre, so $\beta_i(y)=\dim_{\kappa(y)}H^i(K\otimes_A\kappa(y))$.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma jump-loci, Tag 0BDI, affine reduction and truncation

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-finite-free-complex-homology-upper-semicontinuous] to $K$ in degree $i$. It gives upper semicontinuity on $U$; since such affine neighbourhoods cover $X$, $\beta_i$ is upper semicontinuous on $X$.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma jump-loci, Tag 0BDI

proof.text: For any morphism $g:Y\to X$ and $y\in Y$ over $x=g(y)\in U$, pulling the same model back computes $Lg^*E$ on $g^{-1}U$ and then $Li_y^*Lg^*E$ termwise by [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback], giving $K\otimes_A\kappa(y)=(K\otimes_A\kappa(x))\otimes_{\kappa(x)}\kappa(y)$; since $\kappa(y)$ is flat over the field $\kappa(x)$, its degree-$i$ cohomology has $\kappa(y)$-dimension $\beta_i(x)$, so the fibre dimensions of $Lg^*E$ are $\beta_i\circ g$ and formation commutes with base change. Finally, on $U$ each level set is $\{y: \beta_i(y)<r+1\}\setminus\{y: \beta_i(y)<r\}$; by [lem-sc-finite-free-complex-homology-upper-semicontinuous] both sets are quasi-compact opens of the affine $U$, hence retrocompact in $U$ (Stacks Tag 054D), so their difference is constructible in $U$ by the definition of constructible sets (Stacks Tag 005G); as such $U$ cover $X$, the level sets are locally constructible.
